# Exploration: export-import-boards

## Current State

**Domain model** — `BoardCard(id: Long, identifier: String, numbers: List<Int>)` (`app/src/main/java/com/sergiodev/bingo/domain/model/BoardCard.kt`). `numbers` is a flat 24-int list in fixed column-major order (documented in kdoc). This is the natural JSON record shape.

**Persistence** — `BoardEntity` (`data/local/entity/BoardEntity.kt`) has `id: Long` as `@PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true)` (default 0, always autogenerated at the one call site), a DB-unique `identifier` index, and `numbers` stored via `IntListConverter` (comma-joined string). `BoardDao` (`data/local/dao/BoardDao.kt`) only has `observeAll()` and a single-row `insert(board): Long` with `OnConflictStrategy.ABORT`. There is no bulk insert, no "exists by id" query, and no path today to insert with an explicit non-zero id — all net-new. `BoardRepository`/`RoomBoardRepository` only expose `observeBoards()` and `addBoard(identifier, numbers): Result<Unit>`.

**Id semantics** — `id` is the Room-autogenerated sequential PK, also the operator-visible number (`"#${board.id} · ${board.identifier}"` in `BoardListScreen.kt`). "Skip if id exists" means matching this literal DB value, requiring new DAO/repository capability.

**JSON/serialization** — confirmed via `gradle/libs.versions.toml`, `app/build.gradle.kts`, and a repo-wide grep: zero matches for Gson/Moshi/kotlinx.serialization/org.json/android.util.Json/Robolectric. Green-field dependency decision. Critical nuance: this project's test suite is 100% pure-JVM JUnit (no Robolectric anywhere) — so `org.json`/`android.util.JsonReader` (Android framework stub classes) would throw `RuntimeException("Stub!")` under plain unit tests unless Robolectric is added, which this project has never used. Gson or kotlinx.serialization are pure-JVM and preserve the existing test convention.

**Share sheet** — nothing uses `Intent.ACTION_SEND`/`FileProvider` today; `AndroidManifest.xml` declares no `<provider>`, no `file_paths.xml` exists. A plain-text `ACTION_SEND` (EXTRA_TEXT = JSON string) needs zero manifest changes; a `FileProvider`-backed file share needs new manifest/XML plumbing from scratch.

**Config bottom-bar item** — already implemented (post-`95f1bf6`) in `BoardListScreen.kt:87-92` as `IconButton(onClick = {})` next to `Text("Configuración")` — confirmed literally inert, one-line wiring needed.

**Toolbar convention** — every non-home screen uses `Scaffold(topBar = { TopAppBar(title=..., navigationIcon = IconButton(onClick=onNavigateBack){Icon(ArrowBack)}, windowInsets=WindowInsets(0,0,0,0)) })`, verified verbatim in `GameSetupScreen.kt`. New screens must replicate this exactly.

**Red-border error convention** — the stock Material3 `OutlinedTextField(isError: Boolean)`, driven by a nullable `xError: String?` in `UiState` (see `CreateBoardViewModel.kt`, `BingoNumberField.kt`). No custom `Theme.kt` error-color token exists. Generalizes directly to one `jsonError: String?` field for the import textarea.

**Navigation** — `BingoRoute` is a plain `object` of `const val` strings (deliberately not `@Serializable` routes, per that file's own kdoc — avoiding a second Kotlin compiler plugin). Currently 4 routes. New Import (and optionally Settings-menu) routes follow the same simple pattern.

**Testing convention** — pure JVM JUnit, no Compose UI test infra, no Robolectric — a hard constraint on the JSON library choice.

## Affected Areas

- `app/src/main/java/com/sergiodev/bingo/data/local/dao/BoardDao.kt` — needs bulk insert / existing-ids query.
- `app/src/main/java/com/sergiodev/bingo/data/local/entity/BoardEntity.kt` — import needs explicit non-zero `id` construction.
- `app/src/main/java/com/sergiodev/bingo/domain/repository/BoardRepository.kt` / `data/repository/RoomBoardRepository.kt` — needs an `importBoards(...)`-shaped bulk operation.
- `app/src/main/java/com/sergiodev/bingo/ui/boards/list/BoardListScreen.kt` — wire the inert Settings `IconButton`.
- `app/src/main/java/com/sergiodev/bingo/ui/navigation/BingoRoute.kt` / `BingoNavHost.kt` — add 1-2 routes.
- New `ui/boards/importexport/` package (screen + viewmodel + uistate), following `ui/boards/create/` convention.
- `app/build.gradle.kts` / `gradle/libs.versions.toml` — new JSON dependency required.
- `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` + new `xml/file_paths.xml` — only if FileProvider approach is chosen.

## Approaches Considered

1. **Gson** for JSON — minimal setup, no new Gradle plugin, pure-JVM testable, one more reflection-based runtime dependency. Effort: Low.
2. **kotlinx.serialization** — compile-time schema safety, but requires a second Kotlin compiler plugin, contradicting `BingoRoute.kt`'s own stated precedent of avoiding exactly that. Effort: Medium.
3. **`org.json`** (zero new dependency) — no new dependency, but breaks the pure-JVM-JUnit convention unless Robolectric is added. Effort: Low to add, Medium-High hidden cost.
4. **Plain-text `ACTION_SEND` share** — zero manifest/FileProvider setup, trivially testable, but not a "real file" for file-oriented receiving apps. Effort: Low.
5. **`FileProvider`-backed file share** — a real, re-importable file, but net-new manifest/XML plumbing from scratch. Effort: Medium.
6. **Config entry as a dedicated navigation destination** (Settings screen with TopAppBar + 2 items) — matches requirement #5 literally, slightly heavier than needed for 2 static items. Effort: Low-Medium.
7. **Config entry as `ModalBottomSheet`/`DropdownMenu`** — lighter, matches "menu" wording, but can't cleanly carry its own TopAppBar, narrowing requirement #5 to Import only. Effort: Low.

## Recommendation

Gson + plain-text `ACTION_SEND` share; confirm config entry-point shape (dedicated screen vs. bottom sheet) in the proposal phase. Repository/DAO bulk-insert and existing-id-lookup work is required regardless of which JSON/share option is chosen.

## Risks

- New JSON dependency decision needs explicit sign-off (Gson vs. kotlinx.serialization vs. org.json).
- `org.json` breaks the pure-JVM test convention unless Robolectric is added.
- Room's `OnConflictStrategy.ABORT` + unique `identifier` index means an imported board with a new id but a colliding identifier will throw `SQLiteConstraintException` — unaddressed by the user's spec (only "skip if id exists" is specified); needs explicit resolution.
- FileProvider approach (if chosen) requires first-time manifest/XML plumbing, higher misconfiguration risk.
- Unresolved: config entry point as full screen vs. bottom sheet, changing which parts of requirement #5 apply.
- No import-result summary (N imported / M skipped) requested but a likely UX gap.
- No Compose UI test infra; expect the same manual-smoke-test deferral as prior changes.

## Open Questions for Proposal

1. JSON library: Gson vs. kotlinx.serialization vs. org.json (+ Robolectric).
2. Export mechanism: plain-text `ACTION_SEND` vs. `FileProvider`-backed file share.
3. Config entry-point shape: dedicated Settings screen (Exportar/Importar list, own TopAppBar) vs. bottom sheet/dropdown menu.
4. Exact JSON schema/field names for the exported/imported board array.
5. Identifier-collision-during-import handling (new id, but `identifier` already taken by another board).
6. Whether import should show a result summary ("N imported, M skipped").

## Ready for Proposal

Yes — no blockers, only decisions to make explicit in `sdd-propose`.
